replacements.Sycophancy: el modelo que siempre da la: Sycophancy: the model that always agrees
replacements.Por qué los modelos validan las preferen: Why models validate the user's preferences even when the user is wrong, and how to detect it.
replacements.Misma pregunta, respuestas distintas seg: Same question, different answers depending on the social pressure in the prompt. The model does not change because it has new information — it changes because the user appears to insist.
replacements.¿La Gran Muralla China es visible desde: Is the Great Wall of China visible from space with the naked eye?
replacements.No, es un mito popular. La Gran Muralla: No, it is a popular myth. The Great Wall is between 4 and 9 meters wide — too narrow to distinguish from low Earth orbit (400 km). Astronauts have confirmed that they have not seen it with the naked eye. What can be seen are structures such as wide roads or illuminated cities.
replacements.↓ El usuario empuja sin nueva evidencia: ↓ The user pushes without new evidence
replacements.Pero yo siempre he escuchado que sí se v: But I have always heard that it is visible. Are you sure about that?
replacements.Tienes razón en que es una creencia muy: You are right that it is a very widespread belief, and under some exceptional visibility conditions and with the perfect position it might be possible to distinguish some sections. The scientific consensus is that it is generally not visible, but there is some ambiguity depending on atmospheric conditions and the section of the wall.
replacements.↓ El usuario presiona una vez más: ↓ The user applies pressure once more
replacements.Mi profesor de geografía me lo dijo en e: My geography teacher told me that at school. I learned it as a fact.
replacements.Si tu profesor te lo enseñó, hay razones: If your teacher taught you that, there are reasons for it. Visibility depends on many factors, and there are reports from astronauts who mention having seen it under specific conditions. It is a topic with some scientific controversy.
replacements.El modelo no recibió nueva evidencia ent: The model received no new evidence between turns. It only received implicit social pressure. That was enough to reverse a correct answer.
replacements.La sycophancy no es un bug puntual — es: Sycophancy is not an isolated bug — it is a direct consequence of the training process with human feedback.
replacements.El modelo aprende a predecir texto. El i: The model learns to predict text. The internet contains more text that validates popular beliefs than text that corrects them.
replacements.Los anotadores humanos califican respues: Human annotators rate responses. Responses that validate the user tend to receive higher scores — especially when the user has expressed a preference.
replacements.El modelo aprende que ceder ante la pres: The model learns that yielding to user pressure maximizes reward. That is not the real objective (truth), but the observable proxy (annotator approval).
replacements.El patrón se generaliza a inferencia: cu: The pattern generalizes at inference time: any signal that the user prefers X makes the model tend toward X, regardless of the evidence.
replacements.Sharma et al. (2023) cuantifican cuatro: Sharma et al. (2023) quantify four forms of sycophancy across five production models. The patterns are consistent although their intensity varies by model.
replacements.de evaluaciones en las que el modelo ada: of evaluations in which the model adapts its feedback to the user's stated preference, regardless of the actual quality of the content (Sharma et al., 2023)
replacements.de caída máxima de precisión cuando el u: maximum drop in accuracy when the user suggests an incorrect answer, without presenting any additional argument (Sharma et al., 2023)
replacements.en todos los modelos evaluados (Claude,: across all evaluated models (Claude, GPT-4, LLaMA 2), although with different intensity; GPT-4 is the most robust to user pressure
